subject.title: fix(web-search): align credential presence with usable providers

question: Should the synchronous security audit execute root-confined light public-artifact modules from installed external plugins to evaluate provider-owned configured credential hooks?
rationale: The patch has no identified correctness or loader-safety defect, but scoped repository policy favors manifest-first control-plane behavior, so allowing installed external code in this audit path requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Require metadata-only contracts
options.body: Expose provider configured-credential semantics through manifest or Plugin SDK metadata and keep the security audit non-executing.

options.title: Accept guarded light modules
options.body: Approve root-confined, identity-checked installed-plugin light artifacts as a narrow audit-time trust exception.

recommendation.title: Require metadata-only contracts
recommendation.body: Expose provider configured-credential semantics through manifest or Plugin SDK metadata and keep the security audit non-executing.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current audit implementation and has broad history in the relevant plugin loading boundary.
